title: Jesource Jack
description: This Resource Pack replaces the first letter of every word with a J. That's it. JRANSLATING... Jhis Jesource Jack jeplaces jhe jirst jetter jof jevery jord jith ja J. Jhat's jit.
body:
Have you ever wanted everything to be less legible? Is Minecraft _too_ easy to play? Then this ~~Resource Pack~~ Jesource Pack is for you!

_JRANSLATING..._


Jave jou jever janted jeverything jo je jess jegible? Jis Jinejraft _joo_ jeasy jo jlay? Jhen jhis Jesource Jack jis jor jou!
